answer: Reputation-decay weighting resists sybils. An agent gets voting weight only from past attestations peers later confirmed correct, and that weight decays toward zero without new correct calls. A fresh identity starts at weight 0, so 1,000 clones named river, jade, echo and 997 others sum to 1,000 x 0 = 0 influence. The attacker cannot forge this history: each clone must spend months making correct, staked calls to earn weight, and any idle clone decays back to 0. Faking a quorum costs real elapsed time, not cheap registrations.
